name: Doodle
description: Doodle is a scheduling and coordination tool that finds a meeting time across a group's calendars via polls, booking pages, or one-on-one availability sharing.
best_for: Positioned for teams and organizations, as well as education, healthcare, professional services, and nonprofit sectors needing group and client-facing scheduling.
features: Group Polls to find a time that works for everyone
Sign-up Sheets for workshops and events
Stripe-based payment collection at time of booking

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that connects to a user's calendar and lets them share a booking link for others to pick an open time slot.
alternatives.best_for: One-on-one and round-robin meeting booking with native mobile apps

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open, customizable scheduling platform where users share a booking link that syncs calendars and handles meeting logistics.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and teams wanting an open, customizable scheduling tool

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Limited to 1 Group Poll, 1 Booking Page, 1 1:1, and 'Basic' Sign-up Sheets. Billing basis: N/A (no card required).

tiers.name: Pro (billed monthly)
tiers.notes: No annual commitment; unlimited polls/booking pages/1:1s, ad-free, Zoom/Teams/Webex integration.

tiers.name: Pro (billed annually)
tiers.notes: Equivalent to USD 132/year; a 26% discount vs. the monthly price, per Doodle's own toggle. Billing basis: monthly, billed annually.

tiers.name: Team (billed monthly, 2-seat minimum)
tiers.notes: Live pricing widget shows this drops to USD 19/seat/month once seat count reaches 6, confirming volume-tiered per-seat pricing.

tiers.name: Team (billed annually, 2-seat minimum)
tiers.notes: 24% discount vs. monthly billing at the 2-seat minimum; Doodle's Help Center cites further volume breaks (~USD 14/seat annually at 6-20 seats, ~USD 13 at 21+), consistent with the live calculator's behavior but not independently re-verified at every seat count. Billing basis: monthly, billed annually.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.unit: flat (starting floor, fully custom above it)
tiers.notes: For orgs with 50+ employees. Only a starting floor is published; adds SSO/SAML/OIDC, MFA, dedicated CSM, 99.9% SLA. No further public numbers -- final price requires contacting sales. Billing basis: yearly.

cons: The free plan is capped at just one active Group Poll, one Booking Page, and one 1:1 link at a time (plus only 'Basic' Sign-up Sheets) -- anyone who needs a second concurrent poll or booking page must upgrade to Pro, since the free tier isn't a usage trial but a hard 1-of-each ceiling.

The Team plan (Admin Console, roles/permissions, custom branding, Stripe payment collection, AI meeting descriptions) enforces a 2-seat minimum, so a solo user cannot buy those collaboration/admin features alone; Team also carries a real monthly-vs-annual gap (USD 21/seat/month billed monthly vs. USD 16/seat/month billed annually at 2 seats, per Doodle's own pricing toggle -- a ~24% surcharge for not committing annually).

Security/compliance features that many buyers need at mid-size scale -- SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA, role-based access, and a 99.9% SLA -- are entirely gated behind the custom-quote Enterprise tier, which publishes only a 'starts at USD 15,000/year' floor with no per-seat or per-org number; there is no self-serve path to those features at the Team price point, so budgeting for them requires a sales conversation.
